checkerResultInterpretation: Every retained run was green, but a green authored checker proves only what it inspects. The verdict below is based on independent recomputation, adversarial substitution, and whether the binding artifacts alone specify the bytes and authority boundaries an independent implementer needs.

canonicalCommitments.method: Independently implemented uint8(tag) plus uint32be(length) plus bytes framing, sorted-leaf Merkle construction with promoted odd nodes, and outer commitment framing.
canonicalCommitments.criticalQualification: The activation-manifest digest could be reproduced only after reading component-tag assignments from check-evaluation-proof.py. That is evidence of RR13-03, not evidence that evaluation-proof.v3 alone is implementable.

fixedAuthoritySubstitution.interpretation: RR-01's producer-substitution defect is closed, while RR13-01's external-anchor admission seam is real and unchecked.

waiverBaseline.inverseDeclaredOrderWithCorrectPassVerdi: REJECTED only because the declaration differs
waiverBaseline.interpretation: The normative order is identity-bound, but the two pure set orders are behaviourally equivalent.

leaseReducer.validReclaim: Applied pending expiry atomically before clearing the lease

authorityClosure.ownership: Every ref has exactly one owner at its exact derived minimum.
authorityClosure.availabilityReplay: all available => replayable; replay dependency missing => verifiable; verifiable dependency purged or unavailable => recorded
authorityClosure.recursiveAuthorityProbes: 10/10 neutral-key authority aliases under allowed nested records rejected structurally by RT8; the product checker alone accepted all 10 direct semantic scans, but its exact RT8 digest join rejects every changed artifact.
authorityClosure.interpretation: R8-P1A-RR-04 is closed by RT8 recursive schema closure plus the product checker's exact-digest join, not by a general recursive product-authority scanner. Preserve both controls in any successor.

findingDecisions.title: Waiver/baseline precedence
findingDecisions.basis: The contract binds one declared policy program and every positive verdict replays. Exhaustive enumeration finds the two questioned set-operation orders equivalent, so the guard is declarative but sound.
findingDecisions.boundary: RR13-02 is informational and requires no behavioural repair.

findingDecisions.basis: Independent reducer replay and new composed sequences confirm one lock domain, expiry-before-release/reclaim, exact owner/liveness/scope/fence matching, durable monotonic fences, and stale-token rejection.

findingDecisions.basis: Unknown authority records are structurally unrepresentable in RT8, and the product checker binds the exact reviewed RT8 digest. CD-RT-5 remains blocked and V10 unresolved.

residualAdjudication.title: Run seal and PlanId are self-attested trusted-input fields at the EP3 boundary
evidence: Changing runSealRef to an arbitrary well-formed digest is accepted.
Changing planId to an arbitrary well-formed PlanId, then recomputing the manifest and its digest, is accepted.
The C-2 commitments are mechanically recomputed, demonstrating that the missing checks are specific external-anchor seams rather than an unavoidable property of a pure evaluator.
residualAdjudication.whyBlockingForConsumerB: Calling these values trusted preconditions does not identify who earns the trust. An implementer must otherwise invent whether planning, storage, or evidence owns PlanId recomputation and Run-seal lookup, creating exactly the week-one fork the architecture package must prevent.
requiredRepair: The planning/admission owner recomputes PLAN-ID-V1 from the admitted resolved inputs; caller-supplied PlanId never becomes authority.
The ProjectId-scoped store/ledger resolves runSealRef and verifies that the immutable sealed Run record contains the exact activationManifestRef and RunId before authority admission.
The evidence evaluator receives only that verified authority object, not a raw self-attested authority supplied by a producer or caller.
Bind these ownership and failure transitions into the successor contract and checker with positive and adversarial vectors.

residualAdjudication.title: Waiver/baseline order is set-algebraically equivalent
residualAdjudication.evidence: 4096/4096 four-member configurations produce identical verdicts under both orders.
residualAdjudication.requiredRepair: No mechanical repair. Record the equivalence so future tests do not claim a nonexistent behavioural distinction.

residualAdjudication.title: Load-bearing canonical byte grammars exist only in checker source
evidence: evaluation-proof.v3 names ActivationManifestV1 and ActivationMemberV1 record tags but omits their component tags 0x01..0x07 and 0x50..0x57 and publishes no golden for either record.
The same artifact omits the inner tag assignments used for waiver, baseline, policy, and verdict-input records even though their commitments are authority-bearing.
retention-tiers.v8 publishes closureCommitment but does not declare the closure-unit component tags 0x60..0x68 or a cross-language closure-unit golden.
The 594-byte manifest preimage and RT closure encoding are therefore not reproducible from binding JSON alone; checker-source archaeology is required.
residualAdjudication.whyBlockingForConsumerB: Different Rust modules or a later cross-language verifier can choose different valid-looking tag maps while all prose remains satisfied. The binding artifact does not determine the bytes, so the implementation would invent protocol identity.
requiredRepair: An evaluation-proof successor declares the complete component-tag grammar for every committed record, including activation member/manifest, waiver, baseline, policy, and verdict-input records.
Publish cross-language component/preimage/encodedHex/digest goldens for each load-bearing record family, especially ActivationMemberV1 and ActivationManifestV1.
A retention successor declares the complete closure-unit byte grammar and golden, then rebinds exactly to the reviewed evaluation-proof successor hash.
The successor checkers must derive from those declarations and fail if any checker-local tag is absent from the binding artifact.

residualAdjudication.title: VERSIONING v4's six-object historical custody set is unrepresentable in EP3/RT8
residualAdjudication.evidence: VERSIONING v4 requires six distinct historical-* dependency roles. EP3's closed eight-role enum has no matching role, while RT8 requires exact equality with EP3 objectStore edges. No authoritative mapping exists.
requiredRepair: Select one owner for the cross-surface role vocabulary; do not alias historical objects to semantically false existing roles.
Extend or version the evaluation-proof dependency graph so all six VERSIONING refs and their exact minima are representable with distinct typed roles.
Recompute the retention proof-ref closure, ownership units, closure commitment, availability fixtures, and exact source digest against that graph.
Add a negative proving that omission or mislabeling of any one of the six historical refs removes verifiable authority.
Rejoin Evidence only after the EP/RT successor is exact; VERSIONING v4 by itself does not promote Evidence.
